text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'm actually participating in tomorrow's
campus event, the 'Push-Hands Sumo Tournament'!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
With the gift certificate from winning,
I'll definitely get my hands on a high-performance radio!
choice_data_list: I see, I'll be there to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll show Trainer
my cool side♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, when we went to cheer on
the "Pushing Sumo Tournament"—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... F-For real?
You're dodging every single attack... !?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Because I can see it all! Now I just tap that dizzy spot—boop♪!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The winner is Gran Alegria!
Dodge after dodge against every attack! What unbelievable reflexes~?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Even though I'm pushing... why... won't it budge at all...!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufun~♪ Depending on how you apply your strength,
you can push through for like a hundred miles!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Once again, the winner is Gran Alegria!
She completely overpowers the competition with her superior physicality!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Watch me out there!
The finals are finally up next, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: âA resounding impact echoed out.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Oh?
I only put a little bit of force into it, though.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Well, with this...
Do you now understand why I told you
to lean the mats against the wall?"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What in the world...?
The Umamusume... has taken flight!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The MVP prize, the 'Ultra Heavy Dumbbells'.
Looks like its destination has been decided."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Gentle Donna," Gentildonna.
An Umamusume who overpowers everything with overwhelming might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with that extraordinary strength,
everyone present was left completely speechless.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my—is no one going to come at me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
It's far more boring than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "I'M!! HERE!!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Gentil-senpai.
What do you think is the ultimate distance in racing?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I think the Mile is the best!
The Mile is the greatest distance in racing!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmm. ...And then?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest at the strongest mile is me!
Which means I'm the strongest Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I won't lose here either.
In these finals, I'll blow even you away!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Would you look at that!!
Gran Alegria makes a complete declaration of victory
over the noble lady--!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you right now!
I won't accept any complaints later, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... My, aren't you full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... My, aren't you full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
Now, how shall we take them down!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps I shall face you
with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Neither of us has any complaints, right?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
How will this tournament unfold?!
With the sound of the gong—the finals have begun!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amidst thunderous cheers, the heated showdown began...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The throne of the strongest is mine for the taking!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'll at least give you credit for your courage.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
How will this tournament unfold?!
With the sound of the gong—the finals have begun!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Amidst thunderous cheers, the heated showdown began...!
